name: WALK-MAN
summary: A full-size disaster-response humanoid built by IIT with European university partners and entered in the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge finals. It used series-elastic actuators for robust force-controlled manipulation and was later rebuilt lighter and faster as WALK-MAN v2, feeding IIT's ergoCub and follow-on humanoid work.
notable: Europe's main entry in the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge finals
Series-elastic actuation for compliant whole-body manipulation
